verdict.rationale: The GitHub REST and GraphQL APIs are documented, but they are interfaces to the GitHub platform, not to the GitHub Mobile app itself. That makes them a host-platform capability, which earns no credit. Nothing in the evidence shows a public API for driving the mobile app, and the OpenAPI probe found no spec at any of the candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
